nodes.klein: to ripen, become ripe. (tr.) it ripened (a hapax legomenon in the Bible, occurring Cant. 2:13). it began to ripen. he caused to ripen.

to bind, tie up, bind around or upon
to deal fully with, recompense to wean a child (Niphal) to be weaned to ripen, bear ripe…
